Every kill can bring you luck.

Lucky Streak: kills may add a Luck stack, shown before your title. Each stack raises your drop chance, but the next is harder to get. Dying or logging out resets it.

Jackpot: with Luck, any kill may roll its loot again - ten times over! A jackpot spends your Luck.

Sealed Caches: any kill may drop a Common, Rare or Epic cache. Double-click it in your inventory to open it: inside are %coin%s and crafting materials. Luck makes caches more common.
